Form is a concern on both sides. The hosts have four defeats in their past five games in all competitions. Konyaspor have also lost four of their last five and have taken just one point from five away league matches, scoring only two goals on the road.

Team news tilts the selection picture. Alanyaspor are without forward Mechak Elia. Konyaspor list defenders Adil Demirbag, Chidozie Awaziem and Rayyan Baniya, plus midfielder Mücahit İbrahimoğlu, as injured, leaving defensive options depleted. [...] Goals could be at a premium. Alanyaspor have scored 10 and conceded 20 across 12 league games, while Konyaspor have eight for and 18 against. The visitors do have four clean sheets this season, but their away record has been poor. With Alanyaspor registering three headed goals and Konyaspor two, delivery from wide areas may offer a route to a breakthrough. [...] OffsAIde

data.content:
Alanyaspor have won one and lost four of their last five competitive matches, with no draws. They most recently lost 2-1 to Kasımpaşa. Before that came a 2-0 defeat to Trabzonspor and a heavy 5-0 loss to Gençlerbirliği. Their cup win over 12 Bingolspor ended 4-1.

Konyaspor also have one win and four defeats. They most recently lost 4-2 to Beşiktaş. Galatasaray beat them 4-0, while they won 2-0 against Gençlerbirliger.

## Alanyaspor vs Konyaspor: Line-ups [...] Alanyaspor host Konyaspor in the Süper Lig at GAIN Park Stadyumu in Alanya.

Both clubs sit near the bottom of the table. Alanyaspor are 14th, with Konyaspor directly behind them in 15th.

The hosts have lost four of their last five competitive matches, most recently against Kasımpaşa. Their only win in that run came in the cup, 4-1 against 12 Bingolspor.

Coach Uğur Uçar is searching for stability. His side will look to stop the slide at home. [...] Konyaspor have problems of their own. Coach İlhan Palut's side most recently lost 4-2 to Beşiktaş, having previously suffered defeats against Samsunspor and Galatasaray. In between, they beat Gençlerbirliği 2-0.

The head-to-head record favours the hosts. Alanyaspor have won the last five meetings. Here's where to watch the match.
